notes: 'so that' is one rendering of the single waw under rule 55, headed on the coordinator; the corpus also heads such pairs on the subordinator, and the unit note records that.
The suffix of `אָחִיהוּ` is `unrepresented`: the ASV writes 'one to another' with no pronoun for it.
`לֹא` takes 'cannot' whole, no `יָכֹל` standing in the clause (rule 35).
